limitations: No GPU available for deep learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow not used)
CGCNN not implemented (requires PyTorch + crystal structure files)
PINNs not implemented (requires PyTorch + PDE formulation)
Dataset is synthetic and small (97-101 samples per workflow)
Single feature available for property prediction (real applications use 10s-100s of features)
fallbacks: Used sklearn MLPRegressor instead of PyTorch neural networks
Used sklearn GMM/KDE instead of VAE for structure generation
Used Gaussian Process (sklearn) for Bayesian optimization instead of specialized BO libraries
